title: 6G-MOBKPI results: Network-layer and radio-related measurements from mobility experiments on the 6G-SANDBOX Málaga platform

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: whole PING run; sequential packets correlated

calibration_burden: r_n and r_(n−1) are completed previous RTTs in milliseconds; rbar5 averages the last five completed probes. c_q in ms is−0.002897 for indoor random,−0.069945 for indoor rectangle and−0.049676 for outdoor rectangle. The55ms breakpoint was selected using nested development groups. Payload and causal radio measurements are available to comparators, but the selected equation uses history and the calibrated route offset only. It predicts a conditional successful next response, not a missing lost-packet RTT.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: Predict next probe RTT using only five previous completed RTTs and radio asof previous completion, <=0.5s old. No current response-completion timestamp, ICMPseq, cumulative average/loss, future gap, throughput or same-probe radio in inputs. Successful response conditional target; missing lost responses retained when inputs eligible.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Transfer is restricted to the declared source and cohort; no measured deployment intervention.
